# Domain model

One page per entity of the catalog in plain language: what it is, the fields that matter and the rules that apply. This list is generated from the pages of the folder; edit the pages, never this file.

- [Categories](Categories.md): A category is the broad group a product belongs to, kept in a read-only list.
- [Detail attributes](Detail-attributes.md): An attribute is a kind of fact a product can carry, with its value type, unit and limits.
- [Detail list values](Detail-list-values.md): A list value is one allowed choice of an attribute that offers a list, with its display order.
- [Detail value types](Detail-value-types.md): A value type says what kind of value an attribute takes: text, whole number, decimal, one choice or several choices.
- [Product detail selections](Product-detail-selections.md): A selection is one chosen value of a detail row whose attribute allows several choices.
- [Product details](Product-details.md): A detail row holds one attribute of a product and its typed value, such as the colour Black.
- [Products](Products.md): A product is the one thing the catalog holds, with a name, a price in a currency, a stock, a category, a subcategory and its details.
- [Subcategories](Subcategories.md): A subcategory refines one category and decides which details a product offers.
- [Subcategory attributes](Subcategory-attributes.md): An assignment says which attribute a subcategory offers and in which position its field appears.
